name: Slushball Slasher
source:
The Slushball Slasher is a visual novel in which two young detectives try to apprehend the scoundrel who is pelting children with slushballs. Made for the Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022.

[From [url=https://fuseblower.itch.io/slushball-slasher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《泥球杀手》是一部视觉小说，其中两名年轻侦探试图逮捕向儿童投掷泥球的恶棍。专为2022年冬季视觉小说Jam制作。

[来自[url=https://fuseblower.itch.io/slushball-slasher]Itch.io[/url]]
